Chapter 6536: Where Is Bao Pu?

Chapter 6536: Where Is Bao Pu?

The breaking of Corpse Wasteland invoked the image of hell opening. Weaker corpses came from the ground while the true monsters had tombs within the mountains.

Alas, none stood a chance against Cosmic Surge and its commanders. The phoenix flame prevented them from rising again despite their illogical resilience.

The commanders handled the powerful corpses without issue. Their techniques and treasures prevented anyone from getting close to Corpse Wasteland lest they risk being reduced to blood.

“Rumble!” Skyfire Phoenix’s goal seemed to be total annihilation, burning every inch of the land without leaving a single survivor.

The power of Life and Death Heaven was in full display, piercing even the sea floor of the nearby Uncrossable Expanse. Terrible storms emerged in this area and would subside for eras to come.

“Where is Bao Pu?” Spectators wondered.

“He fled already?” Another asked.

“An immortal will never run.” Someone answered because although this legion was powerful, an immortal far exceeded them.

“He can casually destroy the legion, the question is whether Desolate Ancestor will interfere.” A primal ancestor said.

Heaven World was different than Sin and Old World because Desolate Ancestor was here. She was the highest existence; her authority was a guillotine above everyone’s neck.

Would Bao Pu be able to fight her? The first reaction was no because he would be an incomplete immortal.

He ate a corpse and couldn’t compare to the founder of the cultivation system. The difference should still be insurmountable.

“Boom!” After dealing with the corpses, Cosmic Surge activated an immortal formation to seal the area.

Immortal runes within the arrays could suppress primal ancestors and heaven-slayers.

They built an altar and Skyfire Phoenix boarded it, holding an ancient bronze mirror.

“Desolate Illumination.” She roared and the formation channeled rays into her and then the mirror.

Some top cultivators recognized the bronze mirror - a treasure left behind by Desolate Ancestor with the ability to find anyone in hiding. Stealth techniques and locations became ineffective in its presence.

Once enough light gathered, the mirror began scouting the sealed area. The reflective beam from it analyzed time and space, scrutinizing the smallest dao laws and particles.

Finally, a hiding spot made from delicate laws became visible. Nevertheless, it might not share the same temporal or spatial sphere.

An outline of an ancient palace shrouded by flames awaited them. A ripple of immortal power pulsed outward and sent spectators outside the battlefield flying.
